name: onboarding-fresh
//: A fresh install (no notes seen, nothing accepted, Overleaf's PDF shown): no What's new and no 'New' tip; the welcome is one card with the terms and their checkbox in it, beside the switch, inside the PDF pane; Enable turns ⚡ Instant on with nothing in the toolbar over anything else in its first frame; then the three-step tour, each card by its control, inside the pane, off the page's middle; then nothing more this visit.

steps.what: the welcome, its terms' checkbox in it
nothing else: no What's new, no tip, no tour, no modal
a fresh install: this version's notes seen, installed at it

steps.check: (() => { const t = document.getElementById('phitex-tip'); const pane = document.querySelector('.pdf'); if (!t || !pane) return 'none'; const p = pane.getBoundingClientRect(), r = t.getBoundingClientRect(); const cx = p.left + p.width / 2, cy = p.top + p.height / 2; return { inPane: r.left >= p.left - 1 && r.right <= p.right + 1 }; return { step: t.querySelector('.phitex-callout-step')?.textContent ?? '', inPane: r.left >= p.left - 1 && r.right <= p.right + 1, centre: r.left < cx && r.right > cx && r.top < cy && r.bottom > cy }; })()
steps.what: the welcome inside the PDF pane, by the switch

steps.check: (async () => { document.getElementById('phitex-consent-check').click(); document.querySelector('#phitex-tip [data-c=yes]').click(); for (let i = 0; i < 20 && !document.querySelector('.phitex-on #phitex-left'); i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 10)); await new Promise((r) => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(r))); return (() => { const els = [...document.querySelectorAll('.compile-button-group, #phitex-switch, #phitex-left > *, #phitex-controls button, #phitex-controls .pdfjs-page-number-input')].filter((e) => e.offsetWidth && getComputedStyle(e).visibility !== 'hidden'); const r = els.map((e) => e.getBoundingClientRect()); const bad = []; for (let i = 0; i < r.length; i++) for (let j = i + 1; j < r.length; j++) { if (els[i].contains(els[j]) || els[j].contains(els[i])) continue; const a = r[i], b = r[j]; if (Math.min(a.right, b.right) - Math.max(a.left, b.left) > 1 && Math.min(a.bottom, b.bottom) - Math.max(a.top, b.top) > 1) bad.push((els[i].id || els[i].className) + ' x ' + (els[j].id || els[j].className)); } return bad; })(); })()
steps.what: the first frame after Enable: nothing in the toolbar over anything else
